title: MADGDF: Dual-Channel Detection of Memory Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems Using Graph-State Monitoring and Canary Verification
description: MADGDF is a dual-channel detection framework for memory poisoning attacks in multi-agent systems. It integrates a self-supervised two-layer Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) trained via link prediction on clean warm-up data with a shadow-memory canary verification channel. The two channels are fused by logical OR. The archive contains the complete experimental notebook (post-review time-causal pipeline), result tables, figures, and supporting code that reproduce the detection-rate, MPAR, FPR and latency results reported in the accompanying manuscript across five evaluation sources (SwarmBench-32, SwarmBench-250, ToolBench, tau-bench, SWE-agent) and five canary-evasion rates.
